examples.label: Field label with a “what is this?” hint
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-label" site="Global" for="workspace-slug-field">Workspace URL <.component component_name="chelekom-popover" site="Global" id="workspace-slug-popover" clickable position="top" rounded="medium" padding="small" width="large"> <:trigger> <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-question-mark-circle" class="size-4" /> <:content>
This becomes the address your team types every morning. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only — you can change it later, but old links will break.
<.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="workspace-slug-field" name="slug" value="northwind" placeholder="northwind" />

examples.label: Inline glossary term explained in place
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" class="max-w-2xl"> Every page you publish is compiled once and cached, so a request never waits on the <.component component_name="chelekom-popover" site="Global" id="glossary-runtime-popover" inline rounded="medium" padding="small" width="large" position="top"> <:trigger class="font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"> runtime compiler <:content> The step that turns a stored template into a real Phoenix module. It runs when you publish, not when a visitor arrives. again. Editing a page puts it back in the queue, and the old version keeps serving until the new one is ready.
